name.value: Stanley Park Brewing Restaurant and Brewpub

description.value: Stanley Park Brewing occupies a heritage building constructed in 1930 as a social sports pavilion, revitalized as a craft brewery and full-service restaurant in 2019 within Vancouver's iconic Stanley Park. Two large covered outdoor patios and cozy indoor dining rooms serve a west coast-inspired menu alongside award-winning craft beers brewed on-site each week. Situated just steps from Stanley Park's seawall and recreational trail network, it is a natural mid-ride or post-ride destination.
